resources.string: "Zone Hunt shows your position on the map and calculates the game zone. Allow location access to play."

"The host sets zone, ping interval, round duration and hide time and shares the 4-digit code."
"In the lobby the host picks one or more seekers. Hiders get a head start. Everyone plays on their own phone."
"The map regularly shows the latest positions. Anyone outside the zone for too long is eliminated. Chat and the player overview keep you up to date."
"Finish a round. Afterwards you will find all players’ routes here – only on this device."

"Team messages are only visible to players with the same role."

"You have %1$d seconds to hide. Then the hunt begins. On every ping all positions are shown and stay frozen until the next ping. Stay in the zone – it shrinks and moves!"
"\n\nShop: You earn coins for surviving (1 per 5 s) and can buy decoys, camouflage or radar."

"• The map always shows your location.
• Hiders have %1$d seconds at the start to hide. Only then does the hunt begin.
• On every ping, all players’ positions are frozen on the map. They stay visible at exactly that spot until the next ping. Markers show the first two letters of the name.
• If Team live is enabled in the lobby, you see your own team’s positions in real time. Caught players disappear immediately.
• The zone shrinks over time. The current zone is green (red when you are outside), the next one is dashed orange.
• Anyone outside the current zone for too long is eliminated.
• Each seeker catches a hider by entering their 4-digit catch code.
• There can be multiple seekers. When all seekers or all hiders are out, the round ends.
• Chat: messages to everyone or only to your team (all hiders or all seekers).
• The player overview shows caught and remaining players."
"\n• Shop: You earn 1 coin per 5 s of survival. Prices scale with the round duration.\n Fake marker %1$d · Ping camouflage %2$d · Seeker radar %3$d coins."

"\n Zombie mode: the seekers start as zombies. A caught survivor joins the horde immediately, but cannot catch anyone during the infection protection time. Zombies occasionally sense all survivors. Survivors win if one is still active when time runs out."

"\n Assassin mode: everyone has a secret target. Get within the kill radius and eliminate your target. You inherit its target. The last assassin standing wins; if time runs out, the most eliminations win."

"\n Ice mode: the ice hunter freezes hiders with their catch code. A frozen player is eliminated after the melt time unless an active teammate stays within the thaw radius long enough. All hiders frozen means the ice hunter wins."
